Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Thank you for seeing to the books. The thanks for them from Wantage arrived the day before yesterday, but I could not write before as I only came home from Oxfordshire and am paying the price of my four days holiday by having more letters to answer than I can manage[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge
Did I say how charmed I was with your bright little sister in law?[^2]


[^1]: She had arranged for a set of her novels to be sent to the [Community of St. Mary the Virgin, Wantage](/organisation/21), for transmission to their convent in Bombay.
[^2]: Perhaps [Fanny Esther Duffield](/person/2310) (1849-1923) who married (1873) Craik\'s younger brother Henry Craik (1846-1927), an examiner in the Education Department.
